recordedProductIssues: Dimmed scrim and ring on the scroll step card as recorded

defects.problem: Hard jump from the synthetic screen with 'Scroll down' card to the stats table; stats table appears at once with no lead-in.
defects.fix: Add a short dissolve or hold on the 'not visible' screen with the caption matching.

defects.problem: Three-line footnote in very small text, hard to read at normal viewing size.
defects.fix: Increase size or trim to one line.

defects.problem: Yellow row highlight jumps between rows with the whole table staying; fine, but the white space is repeated and the right-hand numbers do not move.

oneLineVerdict: The strongest section, a clear and honest stats table with a restrained highlight; minor lead-in and footnote issues.
